description_en: Queries the burstable pay-as-you-go billing details of a subscription WAF instance, such as burstable QPS
description_zh: 查询WAF预付费实例的弹性后付费，如弹性QPS
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-prepay-daily-bills --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePrepayDailyBills

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The WAF instance ID.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
